page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn9g.64xlarge is a high-performance bare-metal GPU server instance equipped with 256 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9A75 processors operating at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The platform features 2304 GB of total system memory, providing approximately 9.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Compute and deep learning capabilities are driven by eight NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs featuring a combined 384 GB of VRAM.

The instance integrates a high-speed network infrastructure offering a baseline network bandwidth of 380 Gbps. It operates on a KVM hypervisor framework without bundled local ephemeral storage, requiring reliance on external network-attached storage volumes for persistent data management. The system does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its extreme resource density across 256 vCPUs, 2.3 TB of memory, 380 Gbps networking, and eight NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, the instance is engineered for large-scale distributed training, high-throughput LLM inference, and compute-intensive artificial intelligence workloads. The absence of local disk storage presents a trade-off that necessitates network storage architecture planning, but the ultra-high network bandwidth mitigates data transfer bottlenecks when accessing remote storage or inter-node clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn9g.64xlarge is a high-performance bare-metal server configured with 256 dedicated AMD EPYC 9A75 vCPUs running at 3.3 GHz and 2304 GB of system RAM. The instance features eight NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs providing a combined 384 GB of VRAM, suited for demanding artificial intelligence and machine learning tasks. Built on x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization, it includes a high-capacity baseline network bandwidth of 380 Gbps to support rapid node communication and distributed processing. The instance lacks included local ephemeral storage, requiring attached network storage for disk operations, and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 9.0 GB per core alongside heavy parallel GPU processing capability, this server profile is tailored for large language model inference, AI model training, massive parallel computations, and data science infrastructure.
